title: Argentinian-Style Beef Skewers with German Spices
description: A flavorful and tender beef skewer dish with a twist of German spices, inspired by Argentinian cuisine. Perfect for a hearty dinner.

ingredients.name: beef (1-inch cubes)
ingredients.notes: Lean cuts such as sirloin or ribeye work well

ingredients.name: Argentinian chimichurri spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Latin American markets or online

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: To balance the acidity of the chimmichurri

ingredients.name: German mustard
ingredients.notes: Such as Düsseldorfer mustard or similar

instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together warm water, brown sugar, German mustard, and Argentinian chimichurri spice blend.
2. Add the cubed beef to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
7. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve with additional chimichurri sauce, if desired.
9. Optional: Serve with a side of warm German bread or a simple green salad.
